title: A touch transfer assay to determine surface transmission of highly pathogenic viruses
protocol: Add 2 mL DMEM complete without FCS to each container and store at 4°C until further usage.
Sterilize solid fomites in 70% Ethanol for 20 min and place them in a petri dish for drying.
Test solid fomites in triplicates.
Cut porous fomites into 2 × 2 cm pieces, UV-irradiate them from both sides for 20 min, and test them in triplicates.
Expand a sufficient amount of VeroE6 cells.
Seed cells at 1 × 10^4 cells in 200 μL DMEM complete per well in a 96 well plate.
Incubate overnight at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Cut VITRO Skin® into pieces (3 cm × 3 cm) and place on sample holder.
Add 15% (w/w) Glycerin in water to a big plastic box and place VITRO Skin® inside.
Close lid and hydrate VITRO Skin® for 16–18 h.
Once the VITRO Skin® is hydrated, keep under humid conditions throughout the experiment by storing in a closed petri dish with a wet tissue inside.
Mix nine volumes of SARS-CoV-2 with one part interfering substance (3 g/L bovine serum albumin [BSA] in 1×PBS; final concentration in assay 0.3 g/L BSA in PBS).
Tests were performed at two different virus concentrations (1 × 10^4 and 1 × 10^6 TCID50/mL).
Spot five drops of 10 μL test virus suspension on each fomite.
Fix the hydrated VITRO Skin® in the provided gray frame.
Put an index finger on the unruffled site of the VITRO Skin® and print it onto the fomite for 5 seconds or rub across once to recover residual infectious virus.
Unhinge the VITRO Skin® from the frame, transfer it into a container filled with 2 mL DMEM without FCS, and vortex for 1 minute.
Discard the medium from the first row of seeded cells.
Add 222 μL of the vortexed sample to each well in the next row.
Serially dilute by thorough mixing and transferring 22 μL into subsequent rows.
Fix the hydrated VITRO Skin® in the provided gray frame.
Rub the index finger once across the unruffled site of the VITRO Skin® applying light pressure.
Print the index finger on the unruffled site of the VITRO Skin®, lightly pressing for 5 seconds.
Unhinge the VITRO Skin® from the frame and transfer it into a container filled with 2 mL DMEM without FCS.
Vortex the container for 1 minute.
Discard cell culture medium from 6 wells of the first row of cells.
Add 222 μL of the vortexed DMEM containing the VITRO Skin® to each well.
Serially dilute by thoroughly mixing and transferring 22 μL from the first row to 200 μL in the second row.
Repeat serial dilution six times with subsequent rows.
Incubate cells for 72 hours at 37°C.
Discard supernatant.
Add 200 μL of crystal violet to each well.
Incubate 10 min at 18°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash with 1×PBS.
Calculate residual viral titers (TCID50/mL).
Note: All experiments were performed at 18°C ± 1°C–25°C ± 1°C and a relative humidity in the range of 30%–45%.
